# The 10 crypto events worth the trip, Nov 2026–Jul 2027

Source: https://lowob.com/research/the-10-crypto-events-worth-the-trip-nov-2026-jul-2027/
Publisher: lowob (https://lowob.com)
Published: 2026-10-26 · Updated: 2026-11-16
Function: Distribution

> Summary: Consensus Miami (4–6 May 2027) ranks first among crypto events worth flying to between November 2026 and July 2027, followed by Devcon 8 and EthCC[10]. The ranking reflects where deals get done for companies selling into crypto, not attendance.

Founders, BD and partnerships leads deciding which crypto events to fly to in the next nine months. **Skip it if** you are looking for trading or retail investor events.

Most of 2026's calendar has already happened, so this list starts from today. The order reflects where deals actually get done for a company selling into crypto, not attendance numbers.

## How we ranked

| Criterion | Weight |
| --- | --- |
| Density of decision-makers (founders, BD heads, allocators) | 40% |
| Fit for companies selling into crypto, not just building in it | 25% |
| Side-event ecosystem, where most meetings actually happen | 20% |
| Cost and travel for a US-based team | 15% |

## The list

| Rank | Event | Dates | Where | Best for | Watch out for |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | [Consensus Miami](https://www.coingabbar.com/en/event-details/consensus-miami-2027) | 4–6 May 2027 | Miami | US institutions, exchanges, founders and investors in one place | Expensive; side events book out early |
| 2 | [Devcon 8](https://cryptobriefing.com/devcon-8-mumbai-november-2026/) | 3–6 Nov 2026 | Jio World Centre, Mumbai | Ethereum builders, wallets, infrastructure teams | Builder crowd, less buying power; long trip from the US |
| 3 | [EthCC[10]](https://en.palaisdesfestivals.com/offers/ethereum-community-conference-cannes-en-5198662/) | 12–15 Apr 2027 | Palais des Festivals, Cannes | European Ethereum and DeFi teams | Earlier editions ran in summer, so confirm the April dates on the official site |
| 4 | [TOKEN2049 Dubai](https://www.theblock.co/post/393543/token2049-dubai-moved-to-2027) | 21–22 Apr 2027 | Dubai | Exchanges, MENA capital, offshore venue BD teams | Postponed from 2026 over regional security; check travel advice nearer the time |
| 5 | [Solana Breakpoint](https://solanacompass.com/news/solana-breakpoint-2026-comes-to-london-for-the-first-time-november-15-17-at-olympia) | 15–17 Nov 2026 | Olympia, London | Solana payments and consumer apps | First UK edition; ecosystem-specific |
| 6 | [Consensus Hong Kong](https://www.coingabbar.com/en/event-details/consensus-hong-kong-2027) | 1–3 Feb 2027 (expo floor 2–3 Feb) | Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre | Asian exchanges and institutions | Asia-heavy crowd; expo floor only on the last two days |
| 7 | ETHDenver 2027 | Not yet announced (2026 ran 17–21 Feb) | Denver | Hackers, grants teams, early-stage founders | Dates not yet announced; check the organiser's site. |
| 8 | [Bitcoin 2027](https://bitcoinmagazine.com/news/bitcoin-2027-conference-nashville) | 15–17 Jul 2027 | Nashville | Bitcoin-native companies, miners, treasury companies | Moved from Las Vegas; very Bitcoin-only |
| 9 | DeFi Security Summit | 1–2 Nov 2026 | IIT Bombay, Mumbai (Devcon week) | Protocol risk and security teams | Niche, and only days away |
| 10 | Bluechip26 | 10–11 Nov 2026 | Vienna | Stablecoin risk and ratings | Niche: security, stablecoin risk and regulation |

## Left out, and why

**TOKEN2049 Singapore and Permissionless.** Singapore's next edition is expected after July 2027, and Permissionless had not announced 2027 dates when we checked.

**Money20/20 USA.** It ran 18–21 October 2026, just before this window opens, and it is a fintech show with a crypto track rather than a crypto event.

**Affiliate and iGaming shows.** Different audience; they belong on a separate list.

## How to get value from any of them

Book side events before the main pass. At most of these, the meetings happen in the evenings, not on the floor. Decide your three target companies before you go, and request meetings two weeks out. Write up who you met and what was agreed within 48 hours, in the same record you use for decisions.

## lowob takeaways

- Ranking weights decision-maker density at 40%, fit for companies selling into crypto 25%, side events 20%, and cost 15%.
- TOKEN2049 Dubai was postponed from 2026 to 21–22 Apr 2027 over regional security.
- Book side events before the main pass, pick three target companies, and write up meetings within 48 hours.

## Common questions

**What are the best crypto conferences to attend in 2027?**

The top three are Consensus Miami (4–6 May 2027), Devcon 8 (3–6 Nov 2026, Mumbai) and EthCC[10] (12–15 Apr 2027, Cannes), ranked for founders and BD leads by who attends and what gets done.

**When and where is TOKEN2049 Dubai in 2027?**

21–22 April 2027 in Dubai. It was postponed from 2026 over regional security, so check travel advice nearer the time.

**Where is the Bitcoin 2027 conference?**

Nashville, 15–17 July 2027. It moved from Las Vegas and is very Bitcoin-only.

**How do I get the most out of a crypto conference?**

Book side events before the main pass, decide three target companies and request meetings two weeks out, and write up who you met within 48 hours.
